input.description: An N+2 dimensional `Tensor` of shape `[batch_size] + input_spatial_shape + [in_channels]` if data_format does not start with "NC" (default), or `[batch_size, in_channels] + input_spatial_shape` if data_format starts with "NC". It must be one of the following types: `half`, `bfloat16`, `float32`, `float64`.

filters.description: An N+2 dimensional `Tensor` with the same type as `input` and shape `spatial_filter_shape + [in_channels, out_channels]`.

output_shape.description: A 1-D `Tensor` representing the output shape of the deconvolution op.

strides.description: An int or list of `ints` that has length `1`, `N` or `N+2`. The stride of the sliding window for each dimension of `input`. If a single value is given it is replicated in the spatial dimensions. By default the `N` and `C` dimensions are set to 0. The dimension order is determined by the value of `data_format`, see below for details.
constraints: strides must be one of ints, 1, N, C

padding.description: A string, either `'VALID'` or `'SAME'`. The padding algorithm. See [here](https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf/nn#notes_on_padding_2) for more information.
constraints: padding must be one of VALID, SAME

data_format.description: A string or None. Specifies whether the channel dimension of the `input` and output is the last dimension (default, or if `data_format` does not start with "NC"), or the second dimension (if `data_format` starts with "NC"). For N=1, the valid values are "NWC" (default) and "NCW". For N=2, the valid values are "NHWC" (default) and "NCHW". For N=3, the valid values are "NDHWC" (default) and "NCDHW".
constraints: data_format must be one of NC, NWC, NCW, NHWC, NCHW, NDHWC, NCDHW

dilations.description: An int or list of `ints` that has length `1`, `N` or `N+2`, defaults to 1. The dilation factor for each dimension of`input`. If a single value is given it is replicated in the spatial dimensions. By default the `N` and `C` dimensions are set to 1. If set to k > 1, there will be k-1 skipped cells between each filter element on that dimension. The dimension order is determined by the value of `data_format`, see above for details.
constraints: dilations must be one of ints, 1, N, C

name.description: A name for the operation (optional). If not specified "conv_transpose" is used.

output.description: A `Tensor` with the same type as `value`.
